mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (3-month change) compresses discount rates and signals an easing monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen above 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) combined with stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% over 3 months) signals an inflationary environment without monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.5% change in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 4.0%), the market is overbought and subject to profit-taking, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE falls below 3.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 105 signals robust economic activity and strong corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 105 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST has been rising for 3 months (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers market risk-off behavior, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
